Experience required: Minimum 15 years' post-qualification experience in an executive / managerial capacity in the corporate sector, preferably in BFSI; of the above, a minimum of 5 years in a senior managerial or leadership role and a minimum of 5 years in data privacy / data protection or closely allied disciplines. Age limit: Maximum 50 years. Pay: Rs. 26.71 lakh per annum with annual increments. Qualification required: Graduate in any discipline from a University / Institution recognised by the Government of India or approved by a Government regulatory body, minimum 60% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA, minimum 3-year full-time duration; Mandatory certification - at least one of: CIPP/E, CIPP/A, CIPM or FIP (IAPP); CDPSE (ISACA); DCPP, DCPLA or DCDPO (DSCI); CDPO (PECB, provisional grade not reckoned), valid as on the cut-off date. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Type of post: Contractual Initial term of 3 (Three) years, further extendable by 2 (Two) years as per the Bank's discretion

content_sections.heading: How Will EXIM Bank Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of eligible candidates in the ratio of 1:10 Personal interview at the Bank's office in Mumbai Candidates shortlisted for interview in the ratio of 1:10 from those meeting all eligibility criteria If more than 10 candidates are eligible, shortlist drawn on the percentage score at post-graduation examination Only shortlisted candidates will be informed regarding the interview

content_sections.text: Fill the resume in the application format attached to the notice. Send it to [email protected] . Use the subject line 'DPO Application: Mr./ Ms. (Full Name)' for the DPO post. Use the subject line 'Deputy DPO Application: Mr./ Ms. (Full Name)' for the Deputy DPO post. Send it by November 30, 2026. Email it on or before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for EXIM Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in EXIM Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Data Protection Officer (DPO), 1 Deputy Data Protection Officer (Deputy DPO).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for EXIM Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 30 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Data Protection Officer (DPO): maximum 50 years; Deputy Data Protection Officer (Deputy DPO): maximum 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 26.71 lakh per annum with annual increments for Data Protection Officer (DPO), Rs. 18.38 lakh per annum with annual increments for Deputy Data Protection Officer (Deputy DPO).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate in any discipline with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA (minimum 3-year full-time course), plus at least one mandatory data privacy certification (IAPP CIPP/E, CIPP/A, CIPM or FIP; ISACA CDPSE; DSCI DCPP, DCPLA or DCDPO; PECB CDPO). DPO: minimum 15 years' post-qualification experience; Deputy DPO: minimum 5 years. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Mandatory certification must be valid as on the cut-off date. Graduation course must be of a minimum 3-year full-time duration. Deputy DPO: working knowledge of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Provisional grade of the PECB Certified Data Protection Officer (CDPO) credential shall not be reckoned.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of eligible candidates in the ratio of 1:10. Personal interview at the Bank's office in Mumbai. Candidates shortlisted for interview in the ratio of 1:10 from those meeting all eligibility criteria. If more than 10 candidates are eligible, shortlist drawn on the percentage score at post-graduation examination.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Type of post: Contractual. Initial term of 3 (Three) years, further extendable by 2 (Two) years as per the Bank's discretion.
